save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to disk with training state, optimizer history, and validation loss
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint and restore the training iterator, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler
load_model_ensemble: load an ensemble of pretrained model checkpoints and return the models with their args
load_pretrained_component_from_model: load a pretrained encoder or decoder component from a checkpoint file into an existing component
checkpoint_paths: retrieve all checkpoint files in a directory matching a pattern, sorted by epoch in descending order
